karty.priklad: Amrywiaeth mawr o gyrsiau eleni – o wneud basgedi i deganau pren a llwyau caru.
karty.priklad_cs: A big range of courses this year – from making baskets to wooden toys and lovespoons (cyrsiau → [g]yrsiau and gwneud → [w]neud after o; teganau → [d]eganau after i).
karty.mnemo: amryw (various) + -iaeth: a whole firework display of choices.

extra.pozn: Geirfa: f; sentence from the events calendar, p. 221, but the book writes "amrywiaeth mawr" here (agreement as with a masculine noun; feminine would give "fawr") → gender to be checked

karty.priklad: Torrais i fy mawd i wrth goginio.
karty.priklad_cs: I cut my thumb while cooking (bawd → [m]awd after fy, nasal mutation).
karty.mnemo: A sunburnt thumb, BOWED (BAWD) like a hook.

extra.pozn: bys = finger, bys troed = toe (L8); own example

karty.priklad: Aethon ni i ddarlith hanesyddol yn Neuadd y Dref.
karty.priklad_cs: We went to a history lecture in the Town Hall (darlith → [dd]arlith after i).
karty.mnemo: A DARLING (DARL-ith) lecturer in bright red lipstick reads LITerature to the hall.

extra.pozn: darlithydd = lecturer (outside the coursebook); hanesyddol doesn't mutate after the feminine darlith (h-); based on the events calendar, p. 221

karty.priklad: Gwnaeth Tad-cu lwy garu i Fam-gu.
karty.priklad_cs: Grandad made a lovespoon for Grandma (llwy → [l]wy as the object; Mam-gu → [F]am-gu after i).
karty.mnemo: llwy (spoon) + caru (to love): a heart burnt into the wood with a red-hot poker.

extra.pozn: caru → garu after the feminine llwy, but no mutation in the plural (llwyau caru); own example

sever.priklad: Gwnaeth Taid lwy garu i Nain.
sever.priklad_cs: Grandad made a lovespoon for Grandma (llwy → [l]wy as the object; Nain doesn't mutate).
sever.pozn: north: taid and nain instead of tad-cu and mam-gu (L17, p. 228)

karty.priklad: Gwelson ni gangarŵ yn Awstralia.
karty.priklad_cs: We saw a kangaroo in Australia (cangarŵ → [g]angarŵ as the object).
karty.mnemo: KANGAROO (CANGARŴ) on ice skates.

extra.pozn: own example

karty.priklad: Sêl cist car yn y maes parcio. Pum punt y cerbyd.
karty.priklad_cs: Car boot sale in the car park. Five pounds per vehicle (y = per item).
karty.mnemo: CAR + BYD (world): a car that drives round the world, all the way to the Arctic.

extra.pozn: sentence from the events calendar, p. 221

karty.priklad: Mae fy mrawd i'n gerddor proffesiynol.
karty.priklad_cs: My brother is a professional musician (brawd → [m]rawd after fy; cerddor → [g]erddor after yn).
karty.mnemo: cerdd (music, poem) + -or (person): a musician playing to an audience of snowmen.

extra.pozn: cerddorfa = orchestra (L2), cerdd = poem (L14); own example

karty.priklad: Roedd y criw ffilmio'n aros yng Nghaerdydd.
karty.priklad_cs: The film crew were staying in Cardiff (Caerdydd → [Ngh]aerdydd after yn).
karty.mnemo: CREW (CRIW): a ship's crew stuck in pack ice.

extra.pozn: colloquially also a gang, a bunch: 'Dyn ni'n griw siaradus (L10); own example

karty.cs_upresneni: bank or user account; not a receipt
karty.priklad: Oes rhaid i fi anfon manylion fy nghyfrif banc?
karty.priklad_cs: Do I have to send my bank account details? (cyfrif → [ngh]yfrif after fy)
karty.mnemo: cyfrif also means "to count": an account is where your money gets counted – a bank card frozen into a block of ice.

extra.pozn: cyfrif is also the verb to count (Help llaw: y ffordd draddodiadol o gyfrif, p. 228); sentence from the listening, p. 225

sever.priklad: Oes rhaid i mi anfon manylion fy nghyfrif banc?
sever.priklad_cs: Do I have to send my bank account details? (cyfrif → [ngh]yfrif after fy)
sever.pozn: north: i mi instead of i fi (outside the coursebook)

karty.priklad: Rhowch gylch o gwmpas yr ateb cywir.
karty.priklad_cs: Put a circle round the right answer (cylch → [g]ylch as the object; cwmpas → [g]wmpas after o).
karty.mnemo: CYCLE ~ CYLCH: a perfect circle skated on a frozen pond.

extra.pozn: cylchgrawn = magazine (outside the coursebook); sentence from the exercise, p. 219

karty.priklad: Roedd y diwydiant glo yn bwysig iawn yn y Cymoedd.
karty.priklad_cs: The coal industry was very important in the Valleys (pwysig → [b]wysig after yn).
karty.mnemo: diwyd = diligent + -iant: hard work → industry; red-hot steel plunged into ice-cold water.

extra.pozn: y Cymoedd = the South Wales Valleys; own example

karty.priklad: Agorodd y maer yr ŵyl newydd.
karty.priklad_cs: The mayor opened the new festival (gŵyl → ŵyl after y, feminine: the g- drops).
karty.mnemo: MAER ~ MAYOR: his chain of office frosted over.

extra.pozn: cynghorydd = councillor (L2); own example

karty.priklad: Mae'r gwynt yn ffynhonnell bwysig o bŵer.
karty.priklad_cs: The wind is an important source of power (pwysig → [b]wysig after the feminine ffynhonnell; pŵer → [b]ŵer after o).
karty.mnemo: POWER (PŴER): a blue bolt of electricity.

extra.pozn: in the book: the lecture "Pŵer a Rhyw yn yr Oesoedd Canol", p. 221; close in meaning: ynni = energy (L16), egni = energy, get-up-and-go (L7), nerth = strength (L18); own example

karty.priklad: Rhowch eich enw, eich oedran a'ch rhyw ar y ffurflen.
karty.priklad_cs: Give your name, your age and your sex on the form.

extra.pozn: homonym: rhyw = some (before a noun, soft mutation: rhyw ddyn, rhywbeth, rhywfaint); rhyw doesn't mutate after a'ch (eich), soft rh → r (ei ryw e); rhywiol = sexual (outside the coursebook); oedran (L1); own example

karty.priklad: Mae'r llwy garu'n symbol o gariad.
karty.priklad_cs: The lovespoon is a symbol of love (cariad → [g]ariad after o).
karty.mnemo: SYMBOL: drawn in the frost on a window pane.

extra.pozn: own example

karty.priklad: Dych chi'n hoffi'r gwallt oddi ar eich talcen?
karty.priklad_cs: Do you like your hair off your forehead?
karty.mnemo: A TALL CAN (TAL-CEN) of ice-cold pop pressed to your forehead.

extra.pozn: also the gable end of a house (talcen tŷ, outside the coursebook); sentence from Robin Radio, p. 227

sever.priklad: Dach chi'n hoffi'r gwallt oddi ar eich talcen?
sever.priklad_cs: Do you like your hair off your forehead?

karty.priklad: Mae rhoi llwy garu yn hen draddodiad Cymreig.
karty.priklad_cs: Giving a lovespoon is an old Welsh tradition (traddodiad → [d]raddodiad after hen).
karty.mnemo: tra- (across) + dodi (to put): what's handed across, down the generations (Latin tradere) – like a snow globe passed from grandmother to grandchild.

extra.pozn: traddodiadol = traditional (carolau traddodiadol, p. 221); own example

karty.priklad: Mae Mam yn edrych ymlaen at ei hymddeoliad hi.
karty.priklad_cs: Mum is looking forward to her retirement (ymddeoliad → [h]ymddeoliad after ei = her).
karty.mnemo: ymddeol = to retire + -iad: a pensioner who has retired to the Arctic to go fishing.

extra.pozn: in the book: dw i'n dechrau meddwl am ymddeol (p. 224); h before a vowel after ei = her (L8); own example

karty.priklad: Dw i'n breuddwydio am fyw ar lan y môr.
karty.priklad_cs: I dream of living by the sea (byw → [f]yw after am).
karty.mnemo: breuddwyd = dream.

extra.pozn: breuddwydio am = to dream of; breuddwyd (f) = dream (L10); in the book the film Breuddwydio, p. 220; own example

karty.priklad: Dw i'n bwriadu mynd i Gaerdydd ar gyfer y gêm.
karty.priklad_cs: I intend to go to Cardiff for the game (Caerdydd → [G]aerdydd after i).
karty.mnemo: bwriad = intention.

extra.pozn: bwriad = intention (L15); own example

karty.priklad: Roedden nhw'n clebran drwy'r nos yn y dafarn.
karty.priklad_cs: They were nattering all night in the pub (tafarn → [d]afarn after y, feminine).
karty.mnemo: CLATTER and BLAB (CLEB-ran): chatter, chatter, chatter.

extra.pozn: past tense clebrodd; in the book Clwb Clebran, p. 221; mân siarad = small talk (L14); own example

karty.priklad: Wyt ti wedi cribo dy wallt di?
karty.priklad_cs: Have you combed your hair? (gwallt → [w]allt after dy)
karty.mnemo: crib = comb (also a mountain ridge).

extra.pozn: crib = comb (outside the coursebook); own example

karty.priklad: Maen nhw'n ffilmio yn y castell heddiw.
karty.priklad_cs: They're filming in the castle today.
karty.mnemo: From English FILM.

extra.pozn: impersonal past ffilmiwyd (L12): y ffilm Hollywood ffilmiwyd yma (events calendar, p. 220); own example

karty.priklad: Mae Abercastell wedi gefeillio â thref yn Llydaw.
karty.priklad_cs: Abercastell has twinned with a town in Brittany (tref → [th]ref after â).
karty.mnemo: gefell = twin: the towns become twins.

extra.pozn: used with â: gefeillio â; gefell = twin (L10); Llydaw = Brittany; own example

karty.cs: to fear, to be afraid of
karty.priklad: Mae'r plant yn ofni'r tywyllwch.
karty.priklad_cs: The children are afraid of the dark.
karty.mnemo: ofn = fear; OFNadwy = awful.

extra.pozn: ofni + direct object (no preposition); codi ofn ar = to frighten (L7); tywyllwch (L12); own example

karty.cs_upresneni: saying the numbers in order, not cyfrif
karty.priklad: Rhifwch o un i ddeg.
karty.priklad_cs: Count from one to ten (deg → [dd]eg after i).
karty.mnemo: rhif = number.

extra.pozn: cyfrif = to count, also in the sense of adding up; own example

karty.cs: to release, to free; to release (an album, a film)
karty.priklad: Rhyddhawyd Nelson Mandela ar yr unfed ar ddeg o Chwefror.
karty.priklad_cs: Nelson Mandela was released on the eleventh of February.
karty.mnemo: rhydd = free + -hau (to make): to set free.

extra.pozn: past tense rhyddhaodd; rhyddhawyd = impersonal past (L12); date: yr unfed ar ddeg o Chwefror (Help llaw, p. 228); sentence based on the exercise, p. 219 (11 Feb 1990)
